description: Overview of the hosting providers in the Pulse Celestia datacenter catalog: how many servers each lists, how many Pulse lists for each node role and how many of those are Compatible, regions, price range for validator servers, bandwidth billing, the FDP hosting rule, how many Celestia validators already run there and whether the provider status page shows open incidents. Use it to choose a provider before browsing servers with list_datacenter_offers. Celestia node hosting only. Provider data is a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes from Pulse.

mode.description: real = Unity Nodes measured minimum, docs = official Celestia docs envelope

provider.description: One provider by name or key, e.g. "Hetzner" or "cherry"

region.description: Only providers that list servers in this region

name: list_datacenter_providers
